candidates.description: Frame the question, search in parallel, give every source its own reading session, and follow relevant citations through successive evidence waves. Keep a cumulative, source-traceable survey draft.
candidates.title: Academic Survey

candidates.description: Prove a root cause, let the human choose a correction, approve its design, implement and verify it, then prepare a PR note.
candidates.title: Bug Hunting

candidates.description: Define a useful playbook, draft its prompts with the human, then independently verify the process before saving it globally or in the user's repository.
candidates.title: Build a New Playbook

candidates.description: Perform ad-hoc task work in one human-steered session with a required inspectable result.
candidates.title: Free-form

candidates.description: Carry out one user-described request and preserve its result, evidence, decisions and limitations.
candidates.title: Generic Session

candidates.description: Frame purpose and outcome, harvest seven independent and three shared-wall perspectives losslessly, evaluate options and define human-steered next actions.
candidates.title: Natural Planning Brainstorm

candidates.description: Implement, verify, and prepare a PR note for a clear bounded request in one session.
candidates.title: One-shot

candidates.description: Probe, Research, Identify, Map, Establish and Develop: a six-stage feature workflow with human direction and verified implementation.
candidates.title: PRIMED Feature Development

candidates.description: Bind an exact review target, collect safe verification evidence, inspect findings with the human, and prepare a paste-ready response.
candidates.title: Evidence-Backed Code Review

candidates.description: Explore solutions sequentially, independently trace implementation difficulty, and compare the evidence without implementing code or estimating duration.
candidates.title: Solution Exploration

candidates.description: Specify a change, then implement and review one approved slice at a time.
candidates.title: Kiro SDD

candidates.description: Develop a change through Clarify, Investigate, Decide, Plan, Define Tests, Build, and Prepare Review.
candidates.title: SuperDevelop

candidates.description: Approve a reproducible protocol, search and screen through independent lanes, audit a corpus with the human, extract and synthesize traceable evidence, and audit the reporting package.
candidates.title: Systematic Evidence Review

candidates.description: Frame a naming brief, generate diverse batches, analyze every candidate, rank complete groups, research a human-approved shortlist and record the human decision.
candidates.title: Systematic Naming
